summary: reset returns inflate/deflate engines to factory defaults without creating a new JS stream object.

target.notes: Preserve Node Buffer/options/error semantics; platform compression libraries are usable only behind this compatibility contract.

tests.name: normal
tests.input: const z=require('node:zlib'); const s=z.createDeflate(); console.log(s.reset(),typeof s.write);

tests.name: edge
tests.input: const z=require('node:zlib'); const s=z.createBrotliCompress(); console.log(typeof s.reset);
